theme_and_archetype.reasoning: Clarity, authority, and functional focus. Needs to feel like an enterprise control room rather than a developer console. High-contrast ensures readability for dense data sets like users, permissions, and audit logs.

headings.rationale: Breaks the default 'Inter' SaaS look while maintaining enterprise legibility and adding a premium structural feel.

body.rationale: High-density readability for tables, logs, and technical configurations.

fonts.rules: H1 up to text-4xl with tracking-tight. H2 at text-2xl. Use font-light and font-semibold to create tension.

visual_language.surfaces: Grid Borders for dense tables. Glassmorphism exclusively for sticky headers or contextual floating action bars. No soft shadows; use 1px solid borders to define hierarchy.
visual_language.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-6 and p-8 for main layout containers to let data breathe. Tables use p-4 for row cells. Dense headers.
moodboard_references: Vercel (Card layouts, toggle panels, command palettes)

brand_context_strategy.recommendation: Single app with a universal brand-picker toggle in the header.
brand_context_strategy.justification: Maintains a single codebase and SSoT for Master Admins. A fixed top-left context switcher (All / Pulse Fitness / GymAxis) changes the data scope (filtering tables) and subtle UI theme accents (e.g., active states) without redirecting to a new URL. It reinforces that the Admin controls the entire ecosystem.

people_ssot_design.page_structure: Single 'Directory' Page with a unified TanStack table. Replaces AdminUsers, GlobalUsersPanel, AdminPulseAdmins, AdminCRMUsers.
people_ssot_design.bulk_actions: Floating action bar (Glassmorphism) appears when rows are selected for bulk role change or password resets.

organisations_ssot_design.page_structure: Single 'Organisations' List replacing AdminOrganizations, AdminPulse, AdminMemberships/OrganisationsTab.

integrations_hub_design.page_structure: Grid of 'Integration Cards' (Sicon, Stripe, Resend, Sage 200, Orbit 4, Companies House).
integrations_hub_design.card_anatomy: Logo, Title, Status Pill (Healthy, Syncing, Error), Last Sync Timestamp.
integrations_hub_design.click_to_detail_drawer: Shows connection logs, API keys, sync settings, and manual trigger buttons.

staff_onboarding_wizard.flow: Guided 4-step modal or full-page flow using Shadcn Tabs or Stepper.

steps.name: Site Access
steps.details: Assign Head Office or specific sites

steps.name: Review & Send
steps.details: Audit summary, trigger Send Reset/Invite Link

empty_stale_states.strategy: Avoid diluting the surface. Do not show empty panels as large blank cards.
empty_stale_states.implementation: Collapse empty sections (e.g., 'Setup checklist' disappears or becomes a small '0 Tasks' badge in the header). Use 'Ghost' illustrations minimally. Guide user to action immediately (e.g., 'Add your first Integration').

confirmed_order: P2: Brand Context Toggle (Scope control early)
P3: People SSoT (Highest risk, most fragmentation)
P4: Organisations SSoT (Depends on People links)
P5: Integrations Hub (Consolidates remaining loose ends)
P6: Staff Onboarding Wizard (Polishes the experience now that SSoT is ready)
phasing_recommendation.changes_made: Moved 'Brand toggle' up to P2. Defining the data scope (All vs Pulse vs GymAxis) early prevents building the SSoT tables twice. It sets the context for how P3 and P4 fetch and filter data.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Single Source of Truth structures defined.
Implement the layout with pure HTML/Tailwind using grid-borders style, avoiding nested Shadcn cards where not needed.
Add data-testid to every interactive element (e.g., data-testid='sidebar-people-link', data-testid='people-table-row').
